# SnapDisk

> SnapDisk is a free Android app that backs up photos and videos to a USB disk. Plug in a USB disk, tap Backup in the notification, and photos copy oldest-first in the background — no account, no cloud, no ads. Free core (manual backup, 5 GB per run); SnapDisk Pro is a one-time $9.99 purchase for auto-backup on disk connect and unlimited backup size.

## Download

- [Download SnapDisk v0.1.2 (APK, 11 MB)](https://github.com/dzianisv/photo-backup/releases/download/v0.1.2/app-release.apk): free Android app, needs Android 7.0 or later. Not on Google Play yet.
- [All releases](https://github.com/dzianisv/photo-backup/releases): every shipped version with its APK.

## About

- [SnapDisk landing page](https://dzianisv.github.io/photo-backup/): what it does, how it works, pricing, FAQ.
- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/dzianisv/photo-backup): Kotlin + Jetpack Compose, Material 3.
- [Privacy Policy](https://dzianisv.github.io/photo-backup/privacy.html): collects nothing — no account, no analytics, no ads, no internet permission.
